comment: Audio parts the ESP32 pin map recognises on a squeezelite-esp32 board, by part-number prefix. kind: dac (I2S out), amp, adc (I2S in), phy, display. model is squeezelite-esp32's dac_config model; i2c parts carry the 7-bit addresses their address pins can strap, indexed by the strap code (CAD1 CAD0 = 10 is the third) and the register writes squeezelite sends through dac_controlset (init, poweron, poweroff: [reg, val] pairs, decimal register numbers). A part whose sequence is not checked against its datasheet has verified false, and pinmap reports it as a finding rather than flashing an unchecked sequence as if it were known. active overrides a control pin's level: the level that turns an enable on, or that mutes (otherwise enable is 1 and fault, warn and mute are 0). unchecked names the fields (i2c_addr, a control pin) not yet checked against the datasheet; pinmap still uses them but reports a codec_pins_unchecked finding.

TAS5825M.source: TAS5825M datasheet SLASEX7 register map (page 0, book 0): 0x03 DEVICE_CTRL_2 HiZ=2 Play=3, 0x01 RESET_CTRL, 0x33 SAP_CTRL1 24-bit, 0x4C DIG_VOL 0 dB. Written without the datasheet at hand; check before flashing.

TAS5825P.source: TAS5825P datasheet (TI): the hi-fi Lite board's candidate amp. Taken to share the TAS5825M's resistor-strapped ADR (0x4C-0x4F) and PDN, FAULT and WARN pins; written without the datasheet, so the addresses and pins are unchecked and the init sequence must come from it.

TPA3255.source: TPA3255 datasheet (TI): the hi-fi Max board's amp. Taken to share the TPA3245's /RESET (low holds the outputs off) and open-drain active-low /FAULT and /CLIP_OTW, no I2C; written from the TPA3245's pinout without the TPA3255 datasheet, so the pins and levels are unchecked.

TPA3245.source: TPA3245 datasheet: /RESET low holds the outputs off, /FAULT and /CLIP_OTW are open-drain active low. No I2C.

ES9038Q2M.source: ES9038Q2M datasheet (ESS, under NDA for the full register map): the init sequence must come from it.

ES9018K2M.source: ES9018K2M datasheet (ESS): the hi-fi Max board's DAC. Chip address 0x48 or 0x49 by the ADDR pin, mute by register (no mute pin). Its RESETB is not given the amp role: squeezelite drops the amp GPIO when idle, which would reset the DAC and lose its registers. From memory, not the datasheet, so the address is unchecked and the init sequence must come from it.

AK4493S.source: AK4493S datasheet (AKM): the init sequence must come from it. I2C chip address 00100 CAD1 CAD0, so 0x10-0x13 by the CAD1/CAD0 straps. The SMUTE pin mutes when high, so mute is active 1. Address and mute are from memory of AKM's AK449x pin descriptions, not the datasheet, and whether the SMUTE pin still mutes in I2C control mode is unknown; all of it is unchecked.

PCM5102.source: PCM5102A datasheet SLAS859: hardware-controlled, XSMT high un-mutes, no I2C.

PCM1808.source: PCM1808 datasheet SLES177: hardware-controlled I2S ADC, no I2C.

PCM1863.source: PCM1863 datasheet SLAS831: I2S ADC, I2C control; our line-in component owns its setup.

LAN8720.source: LAN8720A datasheet; ESP32 EMAC RMII pins are fixed (ESP32 TRM, EMAC chapter).
